acceptanceCriteria: Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and an applied promo code, when the confirmation email is generated, then the promo code discount amount is displayed for BOTH the outbound and return trip segments in the email body.

Given a Mozio order with only an outbound trip and an applied promo code, when the confirmation email is generated, then the promo code discount amount is displayed for the outbound trip (regression — existing behavior must not break).

Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and NO promo code applied, when the confirmation email is generated, then no promo discount line is shown for either trip segment (no false-positive rendering).

Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and a promo code with a zero or fully-discounted amount, when the confirmation email is generated, then the promo discount line renders the correct value (e.g., $0.00 or the remaining amount) without omission for the return trip.
The promo discount display format (currency symbol, decimal precision, label) for the return trip segment must match the existing outbound trip promo discount display format in the email template.
before.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation
before.title: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation

acceptanceCriteria: Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and an applied promo code, when the dispatch data is built for the return trip segment, then `report.price.discount` is populated with the correct `amount` (value + currency) reflecting the promo discount allocated to the return leg — verified at the point where `MozioDispatch` is constructed before `mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch` is called.

Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and an applied promo code, when `mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch` processes the return-trip dispatch, then the output `SanitizedMozioDispatch.report.price.discount.amount` contains the same value that was present on the input dispatch (no loss during mapping).

Given a Mozio order with only an outbound trip and an applied promo code, when the dispatch and sanitized dispatch are built, then `report.price.discount` is populated identically to current behavior (regression — existing outbound promo display must not break).

Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and NO promo code applied, when the dispatch is built, then `report.price.discount` is `undefined` for the return-trip dispatch (no false-positive discount rendering in the Mozio email).

Given a Mozio order with a return trip ticket and a promo code resulting in a zero or fully-discounted amount for the return leg, when the dispatch is built, then `report.price.discount.amount.value` is `0` (not omitted) so the Mozio email renders the correct $0.00 line without omission.
after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The discount data is lost or never set on `report.price.discount` for return-trip dispatches before they reach `mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch`. Fix must ensure the promo discount amount propagates to the return-trip dispatch's `report.price.discount.amount` so the Mozio email confirmation renders it.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code discount amount missing on return-trip dispatch in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Root cause traced to the Mozio dispatch mapping pipeline. The `mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch` (src/clients/mozio/mappers/map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) correctly passes `report.price.discount.amount` through, so the issue is upstream — in how the dispatch `report.price.discount` is populated for return-trip line items before reaching this mapper. The `generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts` already distinguishes `isReturnTrip` vs `isReturnTicket` and computes `discountPerUnit` via `getTicketPricePerUnit(price, isReturnTrip)`, suggesting the price-per-unit helper may not propagate the discount for the return leg, or the dispatch builder omits the discount field for return dispatches. The `create-reservations.mappers.ts` swaps from/to stations for return trips but does not show discount handling. Zero-amount orders (`processZeroAmountOrderService`) are a separate edge case where the entire order is free — not the same as a partial promo discount on a return segment. No split required (5 ACs ≤ 12, single concern).
